vertical_blocker.detail: The P3 form region needs more generated rows than the source template has, and every rule below the extra rows inherits the displacement. The region's first rules reproduce their source rows within 0.53pt, and P42-R3 and P42-R4 now share one generated row (0.30pt apart against a 2.00pt contract), so the shared-row defect is closed. What cannot close is the row budget: the fills on source rows 0-1 resolve to values far wider than the (project name, lot) and (project number) placeholders they replace, so the single source row that separates them from the shared row reflows into 3 generated rows, and every rule from the shared row down keeps a whole-row displacement, reaching 3.17 source line pitches by P42-R8. This is a row-budget residual, not a missed anchor: no paragraph spacing, line spacing or indent can put a rule back on a source row that the reflowed values already occupy, and reaching the frozen 2.0pt tolerance would require shrinking, clipping or overlapping the resolved values, which the accepted contract forbids.
